proposal.text:
I am writing to express my current purpose in engaging with the Ascension Illinois/Saint Joseph (Chicago) Program and to acknowledge my status as of now in this synthetic QA context. I aim to understand how leadership and program structure align with my ongoing considerations about internal medicine training, and I intend to learn more about the program leadership before any interview would occur.

The program identity is Ascension Illinois/Saint Joseph (Chicago) Program, and I reference that identity here to ground my inquiry within the named residency path.

I note that this letter is set within a synthetic QA framework and that no real application event is asserted at this time.

Similarly, there is no real interview event described in this synthetic scenario, per the context provided.

For this synthetic QA letter, I value being able to identify program leadership before an interview.

Lead by the confirmed leadership that has been documented in the leadership roster for the program, which is cited here as part of the evidence base for program quality and structure.
